name: Speechmatics
tagline: Accurate multilingual speech-to-text with real-time and batch modes
description: Speechmatics provides enterprise-grade automatic speech recognition (ASR) via REST and WebSocket APIs. Supports batch and real-time transcription, dozens of languages, speaker diarization, custom dictionaries, and translation. Developers authenticate with API keys and process audio for captions, call analytics, media workflows, and voice apps.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header (also used for WebSocket real-time sessions). Keys created in the Speechmatics portal after self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free trial / free usage credits available on signup; exact free-hour allotment varies by plan page — confirm on pricing portal
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go and enterprise plans billed per audio hour; batch and real-time pricing differ by language and features

use_cases: transcribe uploaded audio file to text (batch)
stream live microphone audio to real-time captions
diarize speakers in a meeting recording
generate subtitles for video in multiple languages
build call-center analytics from phone audio
